request.lesson: When a refactor must preserve the exact behaviour of a large existing check, capture that behaviour as a baseline instead of enumerating it in prose. A hand-written list of expected messages, sites, counts and attributions is a second implementation with no compiler, and it drifts: three review rounds each found the enumeration wrong somewhere new, and fixes for one round introduced contradictions in the next. Capturing the subject's exact stdout/stderr/exit-code from a PINNED revision removes the class of error. Two properties make it trustworthy rather than theatre. First, anchor the subject by content hash as well as revision, or moving the pin silently makes the baseline describe the code it polices. Second, test the baseline by mutation — deliberately weaken the subject and confirm the comparison reds — because a baseline that detects nothing looks identical to one that detects everything. Compare a canonicalised surface, not raw bytes, where the output legitimately varies (filesystem ordering, interpreter-version-dependent text), and state what capture cannot observe (process counts, side effects) so those get their own assertions.

For multi-artifact terminal gates consumed by a single-artifact capture contract, deterministic provenance comes from a named primary owning artifact, an explicit companion-artifact provenance set, and a freshness anchor on the artifact that closes the gate. Construction tests should reference one canonical gate mapping to avoid duplicated path rules.

Construction tests for a governed field mapping are easier to keep correct when they assert the canonical contract by stable gate name instead of repeating the mapped values in the implementation plan. This keeps one normative mapping while preserving observable test coverage.

When a capability is delivered in stages, advertised workflow modes, required knowledge topics, and validation fixtures must share the same milestone boundary; later-stage fixtures must not block an earlier foundation release, and unavailable modes must not be advertised as complete.

Acceptance-criterion length predicts defect density. Across sixteen review rounds producing roughly sixty findings, the three longest ACs (365, 357 and 267 words) absorbed the large majority, while the median AC of 86 words was largely quiet. The mechanism is that a long AC holds several independent contracts under one checkbox, so a fix lands in one clause and silently contradicts another; that is why the round intended to consolidate introduced six of its own ten blockers. Re-partitioning those three into ten ACs took the maximum to 218 words and the median to 101 without adding or removing a requirement. Cap an AC at roughly 150 words and treat overflow as a signal to partition rather than to tighten prose: one checkbox must be one honestly-tickable contract. Verify a re-partition by grepping distinctive clauses of the original against the result; total word count should rise slightly from new titles and cross-references while no clause is lost.

friction.summary: Three prose-only review rounds argued about bounds that one corpus measurement settled.

request.lesson: A spec whose subject is third-party input needs a corpus spike before its refusal criteria are written. This spec reached 24 acceptance criteria specifying what to reject and none specifying that real inputs succeed; sixteen review rounds never surfaced it. Cloning 18 and later 35 real public repositories and running the proposed classifier and bounds against them found three things at once: a shape gap where the two accepted layouts admitted only 7 of 13 legitimate sources and refused a widely used official repository of 127 skills; a bound whose origin was wrong, because depth measured from the enumeration root changed verdict when a publisher regrouped their directories; and confirmation that one refusal was correct, since the offending repository embedded vendored documentation mirrors. The corpus also distinguished genuine collections from vendored aggregates and plugin repositories, which is what justified holding a shape exclusion. Reviewers reason about the artifact; whether a layout exists in the wild and how deep real payloads nest are facts about the world. Add the corpus task beside the other spikes, record a verdict per input, and require every refusal to be attributable to a named shape exclusion or named budget.
